name: 初めての個別会話の相手紹介
prompt: Create attempt a002, the second and final fidelity pass for this 390x380 white Japanese introduction panel. The first reference is the exact native preview and controls the layout, copy and colors; the second is the current candidate. Preserve the exact text and colors, especially the dark text and white-on-forest-green friend-request button. Correct geometry only: avatar should be 80px diameter at x=16,y=13; the candidate avatar is about 2–3px too large and 2px too low. Set name 「山田 はるか」 at native y≈130 (candidate about 5px too low); subtitle 「やまだ・はるか」 at native y≈170. Keep the two message lines exactly: 「山田さんとの会話がここから始まります。」 and 「まずは短い挨拶を送ってみましょう。」; move the first line up about 2–3px and reduce the gap between the two lines so the second line aligns around y≈238. Move the mutual-group row up about 4px, reduce its icon to native size, and place the label closer to the icon as in the preview. Set the bottom CTA to x=16,y=330,width=184,height=32. Candidate button is about 17px wider and 3px taller; reduce it to native bounds and center its exact text 「友だち申請を送る」 in white. The CTA is a button, not a hyperlink. No blue text. Do not add source English copy, person photos, logos or extra content.
reviewNotes: Version 2 keeps correct copy and dark/green/white semantics but overcorrects vertical offsets: message lines are about 5–8px high at native scale, group row about 7–8px high, and CTA about 10px high. CTA remains about 10px too wide and 2px short. Two-attempt limit reached; no hyperlink.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
